issue_context.body:

#### What happened:
I was reading the doc about NodeRegistration, with an interest in specifying some `kubeletExtraArgs`.  I noticed that the doc (e.g., https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/52eea971c57580c6b1b74f0a12bf9cc6083a4d6b/cmd/kubeadm/app/apis/kubeadm/v1beta2/types.go#L207-L210) does not tell me exactly how to identify each arg: exactly as on the command line (including leading dash(es)), as on the command line but without leading dash(es), or camelCase.

#### What you expected to happen:
I expected the doc to enable me to write some `kubeletExtraArgs` with confidence.

This also applies to controllerManager.extraArgs, scheduler.extraArgs, etc. which hopefully should all cover this similarly (if not now, after fixing ...)
